company.name: Flipkart
company.shortDescription: Flipkart operates an online shopping website that offers a wide range of products and services to customers.
company.description:
Flipkart is an e-commerce marketplace that offers over 30 million products across 70+ categories. It provides books, movies, music, games, consoles, gaming accessories, mobiles, mobile accessories, cameras, camera accessories, computers, computer accessories, network components, software, peripherals, home and kitchen appliances, TV, and video products, and personal and health care products. 

Flipkart, currently 33,000 people strong, has 75 million registered users clocking over 10 million daily visits. Flipkart’s technology has enabled it to deliver 8 million shipments per month – and this number is only growing.

Binny and Sachin Bansal founded Flipkart in 2007, with headquarters in Bengaluru in India. In 2018, the company was acquired by the giant retail corporation, [Walmart](/organization/Walmart).

aiResearchSummary.text: Flipkart is researching digital platform technologies spanning machine learning workflows, language agnostic code mixed search, and end to end automatic speech recognition. It develops methods for determining goodness of pricing initiative, optimizing delivery of products and last mile productivity, plus shaped packaging paper, and customizable trolleys and electric vehicles. Additional work covers user query understanding, recommendation systems, augmented reality shopping, fraud detection, traffic shaping, and data sharing, together advancing ecommerce, logistics, and infrastructure.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Corporate Round round raised $950,000,000, or 6.22% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 29 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $24,900,000,000 to $36,000,000,000, a 1.45x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 74 (-7 over 90 days) and market heat at 53 (+4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
